phases.name: Terminal-hook ownership
phases.description: One owner (the exit observer) ends probe supervision on every exit (D1, D2), registered before the exit-event gate releases (D3, D4, B2). TEST PARADIGM for every step: acceptance bodies are pre-authored by DISTILL; the crafter only removes the #[ignore] marker, records a semantic RED, then implements, and never writes, weakens or replaces a body (testing.md, RED acceptance scaffolds and activation); new unit tests are proptest properties with state-delta assertions over a declared universe (single examples carry a `// bypass:` reason); every cargo, test and quint command runs via `cargo xtask metal run -- ...`. KNOWN PRE-EXISTING FAILURES, not this feature's to fix: the 12 quint_cid_lease_* runs plus a_vmm_exit_ends_the_launch_and_releases_its_claim_for_the_next_launch and quint_flows_beacon_vm_exit_ends_launch_and_releases_claim have failed since commit ba85e05c3 (unbounded post-exit beacon read in drain_guest_report in vm_driver.rs versus the stepped SimBeaconIo), independent of this feature's fixtures, which use non-stepped beacons; flows_conf_randomized_traces and action_shim::replacement_acceptance::successor_outcome_precedes_blocked_predecessor_cleanup_for_every_driver are flaky pre-existing; service_projection_equals_declared_listener_set is pre-existing (see 05-01); the CLI test cli_submit_streaming_service_routes_to_service_submit_event_consumer times out at HEAD (see 05-07). Out of scope: V39, P-12, GH #335/#336/#340, GH #308. SCAFFOLD GATE (every step): no `SCAFFOLD: true` or `RED scaffold` marker that cites this feature's decision ids (D1-D17, PR-1, PR-4, P1, B1-B3, R2-1, R2-2, DG-*) or the feature name remains in the files the step owns (owners named per step; find them with grep). Unrelated legacy markers (for example the Policy, Investigation and Schedule stubs in aggregate/mod.rs, the gateway scaffold in handlers.rs) are out of scope and are not touched. FINAL MUTATION GATE: see final_wave_gate after all 17 step reviews; every `--file` target is a production file. Mechanical test and fixture fallout is covered by suite runs; the step notes retain its review scope.

steps.name: Exit observer fires on_alloc_terminal for every exit
criteria: The 6 D1 tests in terminal_hook_ownership.rs and crash_with_a_partial_streak_is_not_probed_after_the_crash are GREEN with only the ignore marker removed
A crashed Service allocation is no longer probed once the exit observer consumed its ExitEvent, whether or not the row write succeeds or a prior row exists
on_alloc_terminal is idempotent and a no-op for unknown ids; the controls (operator stop, finalize, no probe runner) stay GREEN
steps.implementation_notes: Decisions: D1 (exit observer calls Driver::on_alloc_terminal for every ExitEvent it consumes, outcome-independent of the row write), D2 (replacement on_alloc_terminal docstring in core driver.rs, row-independent and idempotent). ACTIVATES (pending DELIVER: D1): terminal_hook_ownership.rs::{a_crashed_allocation_stops_probing_as_soon_as_the_observer_consumes_the_exit, a_restart_leaves_only_the_successor_supervised_without_a_second_hook_call, a_crash_ends_probe_supervision_even_when_every_row_write_attempt_fails, a_crash_with_no_prior_row_still_ends_probe_supervision, a_crash_then_a_finalize_fire_the_hook_twice_with_one_effect, a_crash_ends_only_the_crashed_allocations_supervision}; crash_ending_authority.rs::crash_with_a_partial_streak_is_not_probed_after_the_crash. Implement only the pinned docstring and call-order contract (feature-delta Interface contract changes, D1/D2); no new public API. SCAFFOLD markers owned: none. TEST PARADIGM and SCAFFOLD GATE: see phase 01 description.

on_alloc_running is recorded before release_for_exit_emission, and an exit available at release leaves no supervisor
A stop's supervision is released only after its terminal row is durable (B2); cleanup_restart_predecessor gains no hook call (D4)
steps.implementation_notes: Decisions: D3 (register probe supervision via on_alloc_running before release_for_exit_emission), D4 (the two existing shim hook calls stay; cleanup_restart_predecessor gains none), B2 (the stop's terminal row write succeeds before the terminal hook fires; a failed row write keeps the supervisor). phases.name: Guest-reported listener readiness
phases.description: Startup readiness defaults to guest-reported listeners without ever leaving main broken: declared_listeners and tcp_service_ports (PR-4); host-side LISTEN reader and ONE shared board (D13 host); guest-listener probe task (D14); removal of the inferred flag in two current-layout steps under existing envelope tags (D16-G1), which removes the flag from all five affected carriers but keeps the parser's working default TCP gate; guest hooks, ordered forwarding, workload cgroup and attach as one vertical slice (D13 guest); and only then the default flip to GuestListeners (D15) with the composed G-10 (8) test and the closing serve+deploy proof. ORDER JUSTIFICATION: the only working default gate today is the parser's synthesised TCP startup probe on the first listener. In the code, inferred is data and presentation only (the synthesis sets it; the alloc fact, witnesses and CLI merely carry it), so D16 deletes the flag without deleting the synthesis, and the default stays the TCP probe until D15. D15 is last among behaviour changes because the GuestListeners default is unsatisfiable until the guest emits LISTEN lines (the guest-side step), and D15 also needs D17 (03-02) so a Pass wakes the loop at once. RULING DG-13 (user, 2026-11-05), not a step: G-10 item (9a) (init's own binds produce no LISTEN line) carries no test obligation, because the failure it would defend, false readiness from Overdrive's own in-guest binds, is unreachable and a report of init's binds has no production effect: every socket init binds comes from guest_reserved_ports() (61000..=62024), the Service validator rejects any declared port in that range (ListenerPortReserved), the board ignores a report for an undeclared listener (S-51, undeclared pair), and PR-2 keeps init outside the hooked workload cgroup. The Tier-3 tests for G-10 (9b) and (10) exist and are assigned to 05-06. TEST PARADIGM, SCAFFOLD GATE and MUTATION GATE conventions: see phase 01 description; `--file` lists name production files only and test/fixture sites touched mechanically are covered by the suite run.

steps.name: Guest listen hooks, ordered forwarding and workload cgroup
criteria: Real-boot Tier-3 test guest_listener_real_boot.rs::every_declared_listener_a_real_workload_binds_is_reported_before_it_exits is GREEN on native metal: the workload's declared TCP and UDP listeners reach a Pass startup row and every LISTEN line precedes the workload's EXIT line
Real-boot Tier-3 test guest_listener_real_boot.rs::a_loopback_only_bind_never_satisfies_a_declared_listener is GREEN: loopback-only and v4-mapped loopback binds never complete a declared listener

The guest sends exactly one LISTEN line per distinct (protocol, port) over one ordered beacon writer (no forwarder thread), draining the listen ring before EXIT; the workload runs in the workload cgroup; init's own pre-READY binds produce no LISTEN line; root programs stay ALLOW_MULTI link attachments
The guest kit rebuilds, the existing overdrive-init guest_flow and beacon tests stay GREEN, and the new aya-rs programs load and pass verifier-regress
steps.implementation_notes: Decision: D13 guest side, one vertical slice: programs, ordered forwarding, workload cgroup and attach (PR-2, P-a, P-b, P-c, P-d, V34-V36, V38, V41, V42 held; ADR-0272/0268). Pinned in feature-delta D13 item 1: a separate small sockops TCP_LISTEN_CB program (same object, P-a: no second Ebpf::load) and two CgroupSock post-bind4/post-bind6 programs; loopback-only binds are not reported (V38/V41); every distinct (protocol, port) is sent as exactly one LISTEN line; one ordered beacon writer (overdrive-init::send takes &mut File, no forwarder thread) and the listen ring is drained before EXIT; init creates ONE workload cgroup before READY, attaches those programs to it, and starts the workload directly in it (P-c: CLONE_INTO_CGROUP; clone3 replaces Command::spawn, the crafter pins exit-127 versus InitError::Spawn); existing root programs stay BPF_F_ALLOW_MULTI link attachments (P-b). eBPF is aya-rs Rust, never C (spike.md). New program files and the forwarding structure are the crafter's (internal). RED/GREEN PAIR: the two real-boot Tier-3 tests are the step's RED and GREEN, activated by removing their pending markers (pending DELIVER: D13 guest side, native metal): `cargo xtask metal run -- cargo nextest run -p overdrive-control-plane --features integration-tests,kvm-tests --run-ignored only -E 'test(guest_listener_real_boot)'`, after `cargo xtask kmod-build`, `kmod-load` and `guest-kit-prepare`: crates/overdrive-control-plane/tests/integration/guest_listener_real_boot.rs::{every_declared_listener_a_real_workload_binds_is_reported_before_it_exits (G-10 (9b) and the guest half of guest_report), a_loopback_only_bind_never_satisfies_a_declared_listener (G-10 (10))}. The guest application kit (`overdrive-testing` guest_app and guest_peer) already carries the bind subcommand the tests drive. DEPENDENCIES: 05-02 (the host reads and the shared board) and 05-03 (D14's task writes the Pass row the first test observes). RULING DG-13 (user, 2026-11-05): G-10 item (9a) (init's own binds produce no LISTEN line) carries no test obligation, because the failure it would defend, false readiness from Overdrive's own in-guest binds, is unreachable and a report of init's binds has no production effect: every socket init binds comes from guest_reserved_ports() (61000..=62024), the Service validator rejects any declared port in that range (ListenerPortReserved), the board ignores a report for an undeclared listener (S-51, undeclared pair), and PR-2 keeps init outside the hooked workload cgroup. Clause (9b) is covered by the real-boot test named above. (9a) is not a requirement of this step. Not covered and not required: the ::ffff:<non-loopback> Pass case (no seam gives the guest app its leased address). The tight drain race stays V36's evidence. Gate: guest kit rebuild (`cargo xtask guest-kit-prepare`) succeeds, existing overdrive-init guest_flow and beacon tests stay GREEN (crates/overdrive-init/src/guest_flow/tests), bpf-build and the verifier budget gate pass.
